subject.title: fix(vault): bound Vault SecretRef JSON response reads to 1 MiB

question: Should the Vault resolver intentionally reject every total JSON response above 1 MiB, or should the cap be raised to preserve near-limit Vault KV responses while remaining bounded?
rationale: Vault permits KV values near a 1 MiB default storage entry, so the proposed total-response cap can reject previously accepted data; choosing that compatibility boundary requires maintainer intent rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Calibrate Above Vault Default
options.body: Raise the bounded total-response limit enough to include a default maximum KV value plus response overhead, and add a near-limit compatibility regression.

options.title: Accept Strict 1 MiB Limit
options.body: Keep the current cap, explicitly document the Vault resolver's smaller client-side payload contract, and provide upgrade proof showing the intended failure mode.

options.title: Pause Pending Usage Evidence
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers establish whether supported deployments use large Vault KV objects or fields.

recommendation.title: Calibrate Above Vault Default
recommendation.body: Raise the bounded total-response limit enough to include a default maximum KV value plus response overhead, and add a near-limit compatibility regression.
